title: The Astronomer of Ancient Ujjain (1500 साल पहले भारत का खगोलीय विज्ञान)
caption:
🔭 नासा से 1500 साल पहले... भारत के उज्जैन में बिना दूरबीन के ग्रहों की चाल नापी गई थी! 🌌📜

1,500 years before modern telescopes, Aryabhata and Varahamihira calculated the Earth's circumference and planetary orbits in Ujjain using just sand, shadows, and geometric brilliance. When the world feared eclipses as mythical monsters, India proved mathematically that they were merely the Earth's spherical shadow. 🇮🇳✨
